description: 5 core story frameworks for YiYi English teaching brand on TikTok - targeting overseas Chinese parents seeking native English-speaking teachers

stories.title: The Confidence Breakthrough
stories.hook: 3 months ago, this kid couldn't say a single sentence. Now watch.
narrative_arc: Opening: Mute footage of child hesitating/frozen during lesson (2-3 sec)
Conflict: Text overlay: 'Fear of speaking · No feedback · Generic teachers'
Turning point: Switch to same child 3 months later, fluently conversing with native teacher (8-10 sec)
Resolution: Child looks proud, teacher gives thumbs up
Emotional anchor: Mother's voice/text: 'My kid is finally confident'
stories.cta: Find your fixed teacher → Link in bio for free assessment

stories.title: Native vs. Non-Native: The Truth
stories.hook: Same pronunciation error. Two different teachers. Watch what changes everything.
narrative_arc: Setup: Native teacher + non-native teacher side by side (fast-cut between two clips)
Error demonstration: Child mispronounces 'th' sound (e.g., 'this')
Native teacher response: Breaks down the mouth position, models, encourages, uses humor (5-7 sec)
Non-native response: Literal correction, points to rule, child feels corrected not coached
Title card: 'Mother tongue teachers create momentum'
CTA visual: YiYi logo + 'Verified Native English Teachers'
stories.cta: See the difference → Free diagnostic lesson

stories.title: The Fixed Teacher Effect
stories.hook: Same teacher = child opens up. Different teacher every week = performance anxiety stays.
narrative_arc: Opening split-screen: Two kids in first lessons (nervous, quiet)
Left side (fixed teacher): Weeks 1→4 progression - child gets comfortable, starts joking, initiates
Right side (rotating teachers): Weeks 1→4 - child stays formal, hesitant, waits for prompts
Contrast moment: Fixed teacher child raises hand confidently; rotating teacher child looks confused
Text: 'Safe relationships → Safe to try → Real progress'
Testimonial from parent: Quick clip of mom explaining why fixed teacher matters
stories.cta: Your child deserves consistency → Match with your perfect teacher
stories.casting: Two student pairs + authentic parent comment

stories.title: Common China-Kid English Mistakes (Expert Breaks Them Down)
stories.hook: These 3 mistakes give away Chinese English immediately. Here's how your teacher fixes them.
narrative_arc: Intro: Native teacher (casual, friendly on camera): 'I can spot Chinese learners instantly by these three things'
Mistake 1: 'I very like it' → Correct: 'I really like it' (explanation of why structure matters)
Mistake 2: Pronunciation of 'R' like 'L' (mouth-shape demo)
Mistake 3: Word order in complex sentences ('I discuss about the topic' → 'I discussed the topic')
Teacher tone: Educational but not condescending, encouraging
Closing: 'These habits only change with real conversation + real correction. Not apps.'
CTA: 'Start fixing them today'
stories.cta: Book a free lesson → Get personalized correction

stories.title: The Parent Perspective: Before & After
stories.hook: I tried 3 English programs. This is why I cried during my kid's lesson.
narrative_arc: Setup: Real parent (voiceover or on-camera): 'We tried X, Y, and Z. Then we found YiYi.'
Before clips (20 sec montage): Kid bored in group class · Paying for 'speaking' but getting worksheets · No personality from teacher · Kid losing motivation
Turning point: 'Week 1 with YiYi, something changed'
After clips: Kid excited before lessons · Asking about teacher outside lesson time · Using English naturally at home · Laughing with teacher · Parent watching proud/teary
Parent line: 'My kid isn't just learning English. She's learning to love it. And she loves her teacher.'
Subtext: Fixed teacher × Native speaker × Real relationship
stories.cta: Your kid's transformation starts here → Try one free lesson
stories.casting: Real parent (primary voice) + authentic child lessons

platform_notes.posting_frequency: 1-2 videos per day during launch phase

engagement_tactics.first_hour: Reply to all comments within first hour
engagement_tactics.pinned_comment: Engage with top 5 comments to boost visibility
engagement_tactics.cta_placement: Pinned comment with free trial link

video_production_guidelines.music: Trending TikTok audio + royalty-free uplifting tracks
video_production_guidelines.quality: iPhone quality OK if authentic; avoid overly polished = suspicious
video_production_guidelines.key_detail: Show REAL teacher personality, not corporate talking heads

success_metrics.micro_goals: 3000+ views per video in first week
success_metrics.engagement_target: 8%+ comment rate (higher than typical = quality audience)
success_metrics.conversion_indicator: Private message inquiries for free trial
success_metrics.audience_profile: Overseas Chinese mothers, age 28-45, with kids 5-14, US/Canada/UK/Australia based
